title: Profile-aware frame compilation: conditional kappa = 5.10403292611078e-5 above frozen #62
body:
This introduces a structural finite compiler improvement over **PR #62's strongest stacked construction**, using only the information frozen at source `ad0f25ff7b23cff7f08ad237c2254e6ecf74257e` during a one-hour research session. No newer community work was consulted.

The new conditional witness is

`kappa = 255201646305539/5000000000000000000 = 5.10403292611078e-5`,

for `T(n) = O(n (log n)^(1-kappa))`. It improves the frozen #62 value `5.101691e-5` by **0.0459048992%**, and our earlier parameter-only refinement by **0.0458849553%**. This changes the actual compiler words and fixed-basis recursive profiles.

## New construction choices

The interval/core-aware scalar graph and fixed I+J rational basis are retained. The compiler now prices complete retired dependency circuits using actual transition child profiles, including provider promotions and deferred cleanup. It then uses bounded moment-improving carried-signal exchanges under the existing linear-independence and distinct-use constraints: **670 exchanges on h23 and 825 on h25**. These are heuristic local improvements; no weighted matroid optimum is claimed.

The cost objective comes from our exact complete-characteristic feasibility framework, rather than selecting solely by wire count or primitive XOR count. Rank-flow identities prove why subtracting linear rank preserves local price order at fixed cardinality. Universal dirty-word proofs ensure that changing the legal encoder/complement preserves arbitrary dirty scratch when the separate fresh-transfer contract is maintained.

| Quantity | Frozen #62 stacked | New accepted words |
|---|---:|---:|
| Roles h23 / h25 | 27,918 / 36,586 | 27,918 / 36,586 |
| Physical wires W | 137,151,806 | 137,151,806 |
| Total rank | 78,860,441,550 | 78,860,441,550 |
| Recursive child calls | 2,301,104,805 | **2,296,434,724** |
| Forward scalar XORs h23 / h25 | 148,958 / 205,650 | **148,852 / 205,629** |
| Full wrapped word lengths | 620,626 / 854,800 | **620,202 / 854,716** |

The original complete #62 profile has a rigorous lower characteristic **above one** at the new bit saving `510429345092917/10^19`; the new complete profile has a rigorous upper characteristic **below one**. The change therefore improves the finite network/profile certificate, beyond refining the old numerical parameters.

## Passed checks

- Fresh final independent replay of both selected literal words on every source, target and arbitrary dirty auxiliary basis vector in both orientations; 31,460 / 41,186 basis coordinates.
- Every frame transition reconstructed from actual XOR incidences; all fixed-I+J profiles, bounded-minor and primality controls, **6,049 / 8,127 CRT checks with zero disagreements**.
- Exact rational characteristic, all **47 strict assembly inequalities and seven margins**, old-profile rejection and eventual-bound arithmetic.
- **53 standalone Lean 4.31/Std declarations** compiled and kernel-audited: 34 new universal proofs, 15 concrete arithmetic endpoints and four reused rational-interface lemmas. No omitted proof, new project axiom or native decision shortcut. The old-profile lower rejection is derived from checked downward-rounded cubic Taylor rows.
- Both full raw words and deterministic gzip archives regenerated **byte for byte** from immutable discovery source and oracle/matching fixtures; the portable regeneration adapter also passes.
- Negative controls reject optimized Python, modified verifier adapters, missing source manifests, negative index aliases, mismatched scatter ports and canceling but uncharged additional scatter gates.

See `research/profile-aware-frame-search/README.md`, its LaTeX paper source, independent verifier, supplied words, exact certificate, Lean package and byte manifests. The earlier matrix/parity toolkit and all-cardinality matching certificates remain in `research/matrix-exponent-synthesis/`; their arithmetic counts retain their separate scope. Coordinate-conjugacy and fresh-kernel/complement variants are documented as tested research directions, including weaker and unsuccessful variants.

The unchanged complete data geometry and rational recovery are inherited from the frozen #62 source. Analytic logarithm/exponential enclosures, all-size framed-word/compiler transfer, finite-alphabet tape layout, routing, prime selection/recovery and eventual setup remain explicit inherited contracts. This is a conditional compiler/profile improvement, not a full formalization of the multiplication theorem, global optimum or measured runtime claim. No claim is made against community work posted after the information freeze. No newly compiled PDF is claimed; the explanatory LaTeX source is supplied.

## Authorship and credit

Alejandro Zarzuelo Urdiales is the human author/developer. The research follows the earlier Archivara exploration and his personally developed July/October matrix/parity work, with multiple AI tools and substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. The new implementation combines his complete-characteristic certification/search tools with the frozen community constructions.

Credit Avi Eisenberg / ikeboy for #62's interval strips and core-aware pair assembly, eumemic for #57's frame compiler, Chafik Boukhalfa for #60's rank priority and earlier exact profiling/recovery, Rohan Arun for earlier weighted matching, and all contributors retained in the upstream notices. Known linear algebra, matroid exchange, dirty uncomputation, Gaussian arithmetic and concavity principles retain prior-work status. Existing licenses and attribution remain intact.
